primary_hypothesis: Hard counterfactual answer negatives from the same mutable-memory state improve query grounding and both-correct paired generation more than random negatives from another memory state at matched scoring compute.
optimizer: restore G8C AdamW state; stage3 lr cosine .0002 to .00004, clip1
loss: mean positive answer NLL + 0.5 * symmetric softplus(0.5 - (mean_logp_positive - mean_logp_negative))
compute_matching: four scored prompt-answer sequences per pair in both arms; all answers are three digits so target lengths match exactly
generation: prompt only; greedy byte259; max32 new bytes; EOS required; exact F=<integer>; no tools/gold/candidates at inference
selection: fixed final step1000; validation logged only; no held checkpoint selection
freshness: all G9 memory values are 300..999 whereas all known G5S/G8C generated values are <=255; canonical group preserves ordered per-key histories; train/validation/held groups are mutually disjoint before rendering
scope: small memory-grounding mechanism probe; not 300-800M and not a Qwen comparison
